messages:
Alex G: Heads-up — planning manifest swap + airgap bundle publish for private/VPC installer (v1.4.3 -> v1.5.0) in the maintenance window tomorrow 02:00-04:00 UTC. Will do staged canary then full cutover. Need signoff on cosign rotations and KMS access. @Maya R can you confirm checksums and submanifest push?
Maya R: Generated submanifests and checksums, uploaded to staging bucket. Checksums: `sha256:3a7f9e2b...c1d4`. Cosign sigs attached. URL: https://staging.packages.redwood/internal/installer/v1.5.0
Maya R: Also added a delta patch for the airgap delta installer (size ~42MB) to avoid full bundle republish.
ops-bot: preflight checks — storage: OK, kms: OK, quota: OK, cosign keys present. No blocking issues found.
Sophia L: Quick Q: rollback criteria? If canary fails we want an automated path. Are we pinning previous manifest digest for fast revert?
Alex G: Yes. Plan: pin previous manifest digest in `manifests/manifest-stable.json` and keep rollback script ready. Canary policy: 5% nodes for 30m. Auto-rollback triggers: >3x baseline error rate OR 50% throughput degradation OR checksum/cosign verification failure. Manual rollback if any attest mismatch.
Ryan T: I'll run the delivery agent and double-check cosign verify before swapping. Steps I'll run: `cosign verify --key ksm://projects/redwood/keys/installer` then `gsutil cp gs://staging/installer/v1.5.0/* gs://airgap-release/1.5.0/` then atomic manifest swap. I'll pin image references to digest in the manifest.
Maya R: Confirmed `cosign verify` output (short): `Verified OK for sha256:3a7f9e2b...`. I also added a note to release_notes.md summarizing DB migration=no, breaking_changes=no.
deploy-bot: deploy request queued by Ryan T for cluster=vpc-cluster-3 window=02:00-04:00 UTC. Canary nodes=5%.
Alex G: Timing plan: 02:00 manifest swap + publish to internal mirror, 02:05 trigger canary, 02:35 run smoke and perf checks, 02:45 if green -> 03:00 full rollout, 03:15 post-rollout telemetry check, 03:30 merge release notes and tag.
Sophia L: Monitoring hooks to watch:  p50/p95 latency, token-per-second throughput, 5xx rate, kv-cache hit ratio, and cost per token spike. I'll add a dashboard and slack alert for >0.5% 5xx increase.
ops-bot: canary health probe registered: /healthz on canaries every 30s, perf probe: synthetic prompt set (10 prompts) every 60s.
deploy-bot: deploy started: manifest apply -> vpc-cluster-3 (canary).
deploy-bot: canary health OK (10m) — latency and error rates within expected bounds.
Alex G: good to proceed to full rollout unless anyone objects.
Maya R: :thumbsup: proceeding. I verified checksums again after copy.
Ryan T: kicking full rollout now. Pinning previous manifest as `manifest-stable.json@sha256:9f1b2a...` for rollback.
deploy-bot: full rollout complete. Post-rollout checks running.
ops-bot: postcheck: all probes OK, no cosign or checksum drift detected.
Sophia L: running post-rollout evals now, will report regressions in 15m.
Maya R: release_notes.md updated and pushed to docs repo. Tagging release: `v1.5.0-private`
Alex G: thanks team — document any follow-ups in the release ticket. If post-rollout evals surface any regressions we revert using `manifest-stable.json` and follow the rollback runbook.
Sophia L: quick note — found one minor prompt latency blip at 02:12, tracked to one overloaded gpu host, autoscaler fixed it. No action required.
Alex G: closing thread for this window. :white_check_mark:
